perfil: In addition to offering long-term on-site support to her companions, Shimiao is also skilled at handling problems herself. Perhaps this is why she embodies the perfect secretary.

Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG. Strike 6: ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG.

builds.d: A ranged AoE build that grants Super Armor upon skill activation and increases the attack range.
A build that adds water ripples to skills, boosting melee DMG.

l.b: Launches more attacks in Phase 1. When dealing DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases ATK.
l.s: Launches ⟦0⟧ additional attacks in Phase 1. When dealing DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases ATK by ⟦1⟧ for 13s, up to 20 stacks. This buff is removed when Shimiao casts Phase 2 of Rising Tides.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, Shimiao unleashes water blades instead, dealing increased Skill DMG to elite or higher-tier targets.
l.s: When casting Rising Tides (Main Skill), Shimiao unleashes water blades instead, dealing ⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG. Also increases her Skill DMG to elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: If Phase 2 is activated but not cast, reduces Skill Cooldown and increases the next Phase 1's Skill DMG.
l.s: If Phase 2 is activated but not cast, reduces Skill Cooldown by ⟦0⟧s, and increases the Skill DMG of the next Rising Tides Phase 1 by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: While in Phase 1, Shimiao gains Super Armor. When attacked, increases ATK.
l.s: While in Phase 1, Shimiao gains Super Armor. When attacked, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: Phase 2 deals more Skill DMG to targets with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG.
l.s: In Phase 2, increases the Skill DMG dealt to targets with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ by ⟦0⟧. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG, up to a ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the Main Skill's Attack Range. Increases Crit DMG of Phase 2. When hitting different targets in Phase 1, increases Crit Rate.
l.s: Increases the ⟦0⟧ of Rising Tides (Main Skill). Increases Crit DMG of Phase 2 by ⟦1⟧. With each new target hit in Phase 1, increases Crit Rate by ⟦2⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, creates water ripples based on the number of spins. The water ripples deal DMG and can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: When casting Rising Tides (Main Skill), for every ⟦0⟧ spins, Shimiao creates a water ripple, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG.  The water ripples can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: When Shimiao casts Rising Tides Phase 2 and kills a target with ⟨Freeze⟩, the Skill can be cast again immediately. Also increases Skill DMG.
l.s: When Shimiao casts Rising Tides Phase 2 and kills a target with ⟨Freeze⟩, the Skill can be cast again immediately. Also increases Skill DMG by 116% for 6s, up to ⟦0⟧ stacks.  This effect can only be triggered ⟦1⟧ times per Skill cast.

l.b: When Shimiao deals DMG, she creates water ripples that can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: When Shimiao deals DMG, there is a 15% chance to create water ripples, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s. The water ripples can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: When casting a skill or dodging, Shimiao creates small water puddles.
l.s: When casting a Skill or dodging, Shimiao creates small water puddles, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG per sec for a total of 10s. This effect can only be triggered once every 10s.

l.b: After casting Phase 2, enhances the Auto Attack.
l.s: Within 10s after casting Phase 2, increases the Attack Range of Shimiao's Auto Attack and its Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. Also, the final strike of Auto Attack becomes a 2-hit combo.

l.b: When Shimiao deals DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ with an Auto Attack, increases her ATK SPD and Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Shimiao deals DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ with an Auto Attack, increases her ATK SPD by 5% and Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: The Main Skill applies a bonus effect to targets with ⟨Chill⟩.
l.s: Increases Resilience Break Efficiency of Rising Tides (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧ against targets with ⟨Chill⟩. If the target also has ⟨Resilience Break⟩, increases Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases the sweeping strike's Attack Range. Also increases Shimiao's Ultimate DMG to targets with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩.
l.s: When casting Flood Mantra (Ultimate), increases the sweeping strike's Attack Range. Also increases Shimiao's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ to targets with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩.

l.b: The Ultimate deals more Ultimate DMG to targets with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG.
l.s: When casting Flood Mantra (Ultimate), increases the Ultimate DMG dealt to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ by ⟦0⟧. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG, up to a ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When casting Flood Mantra (Ultimate), Shimiao creates small water puddles, dealing DMG.
l.s: When launching the final strike of Flood Mantra, Shimiao creates 3 small water puddles, each dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Ultimate DMG. For each target killed, creates 1 additional puddle, up to 10 puddles.

builds.d: A build that increases the number and speed of water blades, enabling sustained high single-target DPS.
A versatile DPS build that extends the duration and allows water blades to penetrate targets with enhanced single-target DMG.

l.b: Increases the number and Skill DMG of the Support Skill's water blades.
l.s: When casting Aqua Aide (Support Skill), Shimiao unleashes more water blades, and her Skill DMG is increased by ⟦0⟧.  For every 3 water blades fired, unleashes an additional medium water blade, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG.

l.b: The Support Skill has a chance to fire additional water pellets when shooting water blades, dealing DMG. Also increases Shimiao's ATK.
l.s: Casting Aqua Aide (Support Skill) has a 50% chance to fire additional water pellets along with the water blades, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG. Also increases Shimiao's ATK by ⟦1⟧ for 5s, up to 20 stacks.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases Shimiao's ATK.
l.s: When Aqua Aide (Support Skill) deals DMG to elite or higher-tier targets, increases Shimiao's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 1s, up to 50 stacks.

l.b: Aqua Aide (Support Skill) can slow targets and its Skill DMG is increased.
l.s: Aqua Aide (Support Skill) can slow targets. When there are 2 or more slowed targets around Shimiao, increases her Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: When the Support Skill deals DMG, increases Shimiao's ATK.
l.s: When Aqua Aide (Support Skill) deals DMG, increases Shimiao's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, up to 15 stacks.

l.b: Increases Skill DMG of the Support Skill's water blades. Aqua Aide (Support Skill) deals DMG with a major water blade that can pierce through targets.
l.s: When casting Aqua Aide (Support Skill), unleashes one major water blade that pierces through the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG.  Also increases all water blades' Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: While the Support Skill is active, Shimiao follows the Main Trekker and launches attacks, increasing her water blades' Skill DMG periodically.
l.s: While Aqua Aide (Support Skill) is active, Shimiao follows the Main Trekker and launches attacks, increasing the next water blade's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ every 1.5s.

l.b: When Shimiao kills a target, she creates water ripples that can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: When Shimiao kills a target, she creates water ripples, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s. The water ripples can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: When Shimiao is on the battlefield, she creates water ripples that can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: When Shimiao is on the battlefield, she creates water ripples, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s.  The water ripples can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: When Shimiao remains stationary, increases her ATK over time.
l.s: When Shimiao remains stationary, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, up to 10 stacks.

l.b: When Shimiao enters combat, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When Shimiao enters combat, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s.

l.b: The Support Skill applies a bonus effect to targets with ⟨Chill⟩.
l.s: Increases Resilience Break Efficiency of Aqua Aide (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧ against targets with ⟨Chill⟩. If the target also has ⟨Resilience Break⟩, increases Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Shimiao kills a target with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩, she gains Energy.
l.s: When Shimiao kills a target with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩, she gains ⟦0⟧ Energy. This effect can only be triggered 3 times every 5s.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases the sweeping strike's Attack Range. Also increases Shimiao's Ultimate DMG to targets with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩.
l.s: When casting Flood Mantra (Ultimate), increases the sweeping strike's Attack Range. Also increases Shimiao's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ to targets with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩.

l.b: The Ultimate deals more Ultimate DMG to targets with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG.
l.s: When casting Flood Mantra (Ultimate), increases the Ultimate DMG dealt to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ by ⟦0⟧. The lower the target's HP, the higher the DMG, up to a ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When casting Flood Mantra (Ultimate), Shimiao creates small water puddles, dealing DMG.
l.s: When launching the final strike of Flood Mantra, Shimiao creates 3 small water puddles, each dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Ultimate DMG. For each target killed, creates 1 additional puddle, up to 10 puddles.
